about_the_game:
Trail Racer - Thrilling Battle Royale Racing!

Trail Racer is an exhilarating battle royale-style racing game. Speed through confined maps, leaving a trail behind to trap your opponents, and fight to be the last one standing. Combining high-speed racing with strategic gameplay, this game challenges you to go beyond pure speed, predict your rivals' moves, and ambush them in intense survival competition.

Game Features

Battle Royale Racing – Survive in a shrinking map where both speed and strategy are crucial for victory!

Diverse Vehicles & Customization – Upgrade your car to match your racing style and equip unique trails to create your own signature playstyle.

Multiplayer Battles (Up to 8 Players) – Compete with friends or challenge players from around the world to prove your skills!

Speed Mode & Item Mode – Experience two exciting game modes: Speed Mode, where raw racing skills determine the winner, and Item Mode, where strategic use of power-ups can turn the tide of the race.

Varied Maps & Themes – Race through diverse environments, including grasslands, cities, deserts, and icy terrains, each offering a unique racing experience.

XP & Reward System – Earn XP and coins by winning races, unlock more powerful vehicles, and collect stylish trails!

Are you ready to become the ultimate racer in Trail Racer? Jump in and start racing now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit only
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Trail Racer is a battle royale racing game that thrillingly survives opponents with various items or breaking skills, leaving their tails behind in a limited map. Survive speed and item mode that can be enjoyed online by up to eight people at a time.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Norwegian, Polish, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Hebrew
